items.html: *After we explained the aspect of the Keter and Hochma of AA, which are his two heads, which divided into three heads, as above in the two chapters that preceded, and we also explained in the manner of the generality how the seven lower [Sefirot] of Atik clothed in the seven corrections of the Rosh of AA, we now return to explain the matter of the seven corrections in detail. And it has already been explained there that the Hesed of Atik clothed in the Keter of AA, which is the skull, the first head of AA.
